from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from aos7_mailtodo import summarize,time

class TestMailtodo(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reply_and_negative_floor(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp); inbox=root/'bob/inbox'; inbox.mkdir(parents=True)
            (inbox/'20261009T0400-q.md').write_text('---\nid: q\nfrom: alice\nto: bob\nat: 2026-10-09T04:00:00Z\nstatus: REQUEST\n---\n# q\n')
            now=time('2026-10-09T02:00:30Z')
            self.assertEqual(summarize(root,now)['open'][0]['age_min'],-120)
            done=root/'alice/inbox/done'; done.mkdir(parents=True)
            (done/'20261009T0200-r.md').write_text('---\nid: r\nfrom: bob\nto: alice\nat: 2026-10-09T02:00:00Z\nstatus: BLOCKED\nre: q\n---\n# r\n')
            self.assertEqual(summarize(root,now)['open'],[])
            self.assertEqual(summarize(root,now)['boxes']['alice']['done'],1)
    def test_duplicate_and_invalid(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp); inbox=root/'bob/inbox'; inbox.mkdir(parents=True)
            for suffix in ('a','b'):
                (inbox/f'20261009T0200-{suffix}.md').write_text('---\nid: q\nfrom: alice\nto: bob\nat: 2026-10-09T04:00:00Z\nstatus: REQUEST\n---\n')
            (inbox/'bad.md').write_text('# no frontmatter')
            out=summarize(root,time('2026-10-09T02:00:00Z'))
            self.assertEqual(len(out['open']),1)
            self.assertEqual(out['boxes']['bob']['inbox'],{'REQUEST':1})
            self.assertEqual([x['why'] for x in out['bad']],['dup_id','no_frontmatter'])
